watch.summary: The creator reacts with loud shock and disbelief to an incredible shot during a pro Valorant match.

beats.what: Creator watches the Valorant tournament match silently.
The pro player makes an incredible kill on screen.
Creator screams in disbelief, 'How does he do that?!'
Creator holds his cap/forehead in amazement as the match continues.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: This is a hype reaction to an impressive esports play rather than a structured comedy clip. It relies on the viewer understanding Valorant gameplay to appreciate the shock value of the moment.
